question: When AI tools make more work but not more results, how do we measure what really helps?
reflection: AI that guides a surgeon's eye or runs a careful lab test could help many people, if we judge it by real outcomes rather than activity.

sources.subject: Meta could spend $10B on its AI rival
Anthropic MHS, LAION 10M-Hour Video Dataset, Google GlucoFM Model

one_line: AI is moving into operating rooms and labs, while one large company's experience shows that more AI output does not always mean more value.

top_stories.title: More code, few more features at Meta
top_stories.what: Meta's AI tools reportedly produced over three times more code changes but only about a third more features for users, and plans for deep team cuts were pulled back after staff pushback and a rise in incidents.
top_stories.why: This is a useful case for any organisation that measures AI success by activity instead of outcomes.

top_stories.title: AI watches live video during brain surgery
top_stories.what: Surgeons at a London hospital removed a pituitary tumour while an AI tool reviewed the live camera feed to point out hidden vessels and nerves, with surgeons fully in charge.
top_stories.why: Hospitals will want trial evidence on how surgeons use and trust such real-time prompts.

top_stories.title: A shared plug for AI and lab machines
top_stories.what: Anthropic released a preview standard that lets AI agents control lab equipment without custom code, and early partners report experiments shortened from weeks to a day.
top_stories.why: Labs could automate routine experiments, but safety checks on physical actions become essential.

saudi_lens.text: Saudi hospitals expanding surgical capacity could follow the UK trial closely as a model for testing real-time AI support with surgeons in control.

idea.title: Outcome metrics for AI at work
idea.pitch: Help organisations replace activity counts with outcome measures when judging AI tools, using staff interviews and before-and-after data.
idea.first_step: Draft a one-page list of output versus outcome measures for a typical office team.

idea_kids.title: Busy or useful?
idea_kids.pitch: A classroom challenge where teams build a paper bridge and learn that more pieces does not always mean a stronger result.
idea_kids.first_step: Prepare paper, tape and a small weight to test each bridge.
